accepted.label: String Encoding and Decoding in Python
accepted.description: Understanding that strings in Python 3 are sequences of Unicode characters, and how to encode strings to bytes using specified encodings (e.g., UTF-8) and decode bytes back to strings, handling potential encoding errors.
coverage_criteria: Student can describe the difference between a string and a bytes object.
Given a string and an encoding name, student can write code to encode and decode it correctly.
accepted.merge_rationale: Single candidate provides a self-contained teachable concept on text encoding and decoding, fundamental for NLP text preprocessing.
